name: Tan Wei Liang
bio:
Tan Wei Liang's journey in motorsport began unexpectedly, initially tinkering with engines in his youth before formalizing his engineering knowledge at the National University of Singapore. After graduating, he joined a local racing team, quickly rising through the ranks due to his meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities. His keen eye for spotting mechanical inefficiencies led to several key victories, drawing the attention of Elite Motorsport, where he now leads the engineering team.

As Chief Engineer, Tan is renowned for his systematic approach to car development and race strategy. He emphasizes data-driven decision-making, ensuring every adjustment is backed by thorough analysis. While not always the most outspoken, his calm demeanor and unwavering dedication provide a sense of stability and confidence to the team. He believes in continuous improvement and is always seeking innovative solutions to gain a competitive edge, making him a valuable asset at Elite Motorsport.

What distinguishes Tan is his ability to blend cutting-edge technology with practical experience. He is as comfortable diving into complex simulations as he is getting his hands dirty in the garage. His dedication to perfection and his uncanny knack for diagnosing issues under pressure make him a formidable force in the pit lane.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Tan is of average height, with a slightly weathered face that reflects years spent in the high-pressure environment of motorsport.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas
Has a habit of cleaning his glasses meticulously before making any critical decisions
Insists on drinking chrysanthemum tea during every race weekend for good luck
